frame_scope: Read each reference COMPLETE.json: native waves and source frame definitions are independently prepared; no fit alignment or C renormalization.
loss_definition: Same native3pair-window/gap RMS normalizers and fixed Gamma C3/TR training density; band energy/wave weights[1,1,.5] normalized on source-capacity-eligible bands. Lowest always active. All12 angles retained. Positive constant mass. Regularization center from sourceGamma Fourier coefficients. Native C projected by fixed plus layer combination and never renormalized.
overlap_scope: Resolved pair overlap and degenerate-cluster coverage are separate. Native energy gaps retain their original meaning.
overlap_plot_label: Native pair/group probability; squares: degenerate model subspace coverage
source_irrep_constraints: IRREP_CONSTRAINTS.json: fixed-source Gamma A/E order; no added Hamiltonian coefficients.
plot_calibration_label: all12-angle joint fit with source-capacity target scope
plot_scope_note: Open grey higher bands: outside retained bonding sector; lowest pair fitted at every angle.
scope: First pair all12 angles; higher pairs only if full-path fixed bonding principal capture>=.98, determined before fitting. Full three-band diagnostics retained; not the same target scope as the two-component9/10p baselines.
extra_Hamiltonian: h=-A_b laplacian+V_bc c1+V_bs s1+V2c c2; spin spectator.
spin: Fixed bonding spatial envelope with spectator spin; native SOC states retained as the reference.
summary_scope: Existing summary is a full3-pair diagnostic, including high-angle target states outside the retained bonding orbital; it is not the fitted-window RMS.
